title: Improved Swiss-rolling method for histological analyses of colon tissue
author: Le Naour, Montégut, et al.
materials: -150-µm diameter minuten pins (n°15 from Sphinx can be purchased from taxidermy stores).-Bond RX multiplex immunohistochemistry stainer (Leica).-HistoCore Arcadia H - Heated Paraffin Embedding Station (Leica).-HistoCore Arcadia C - Cold Plate (Leica).-Large-eye tapestry needles (Size 20, Bohin).-Microtome (#RM2245, Leica).-Tissue processor (#ASP300, Leica).

-1 mL Syringe injeckt-F 1 ml (#9,166,017 V, B.Braun).-5 mL polystyrene round-bottom tube (#352,054, Corning).-500 mL beaker.-Forceps (#11,650–10, #11,650–11 or #11,602–14, Phymep).-Petri dishes (#BP94A-01, Corning).-Plastic gavage needles (#FTP-20–38, Phymep).-Scissors (#14,958–09, #14,959–09, #14,084–08 or #14,085–08, Phymep).-Tissue processing/embedding cassette (#M505–2, Simport).

-Anti-CD3, clone D4V8L (#99940S, Cell Signaling).-BOND Dewax solution (#AR9222, Leica).-DAB Substrate Kit (# 34,002, ThermoFisher).-Eosin-Y aqueous (#6,766,010, MM France).-Ethanol absolute (#20,821.310 or #20,821.365 VWR).-Haemalum-Shorr staining solution (#720–0330, VWR)Paraffin (#39V2001 or #39,601,006, Leica).-Phosphate buffered saline (#100,123, Gibco).-Pierce™ 16% formaldehyde (w/v), methanol-free (#28,908, Thermo Fisher Scientific).-Rabbit HRP PowerVision Kit (#PV6119, Leica).-Saffron (natural), flower (#720–0184, VWR).-Sub-X clearing medium (#3,803,672, Leica).

In the lab:-Preparation of 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA): dilute 10 mL of Pierce™ 16% formaldehyde (w/v), methanol-free (#28,908, Thermo Fisher Scientific) in 30 mL of phosphate-buffered saline (PBS).-Prepare 500 mL of 70% ethanol (EtOH): dilute 350 mL absolute EtOH in 150 mL of water.-Turn large-eye tapestry needles (size 20–22) into two-tinned fork by cutting the eye in half with scissors.

CD3 staining
-Incubate the slide in epitope retrieval solution 2 (pH 9) for 20 min at 100 °C.-Block endogenous peroxidase with 3% hydrogen peroxide in deionized water, for 10 min.-Rinse well with Bond wash buffer.-Incubate the slides with anti-CD3 antibody (1/100, clone D4V8L, #99,940, Cell Signaling) for 1 h at room temperature.-Rinse well twice with Bond wash buffer.-Incubate the slides with the “ready to use” Poly-HRP anti-Rabbit IgG (#PV6119, Leica) for 30 min at room temperature.-Rinse well twice with buffer.-Wash in buffer for 5 min.-Reveal using 3,3′-Diaminobenzidine (DAB, # 34,002, ThermoFisher) 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare fixation and ethanol solutions
steps.instruction: Dilute 10 mL of Pierce™ 16 % formaldehyde (w/v, methanol‑free, #28,908) with 30 mL PBS to obtain 4 % PFA; prepare 500 mL of 70 % ethanol by mixing 350 mL absolute ethanol with 150 mL water; cut the eye of a size‑20–22 large‑eye tapestry needle in half with scissors to make a two‑tined fork.

steps.title: Euthanize mouse and expose abdomen
steps.instruction: Sacrifice the mouse by cervical dislocation, wet the abdominal fur, make a small V‑shaped incision in the upper abdomen, then using round‑tip scissors make a xypho‑pubic incision through skin and peritoneum.

steps.title: Dissect and clean colon
steps.instruction: Disentangle the intestinal tract, retrieve the colon, place it in a petri dish with ice‑cold PBS, remove surrounding fat, flush the lumen repeatedly with ice‑cold PBS using a gavage needle to eliminate feces, transfer the colon to a fresh ice‑cold PBS dish and cut it open longitudinally.

steps.title: Flatten and roll colon
steps.instruction: Flatten the colon lumen side up with ball‑tip scissors, insert the proximal end between the two tines of the homemade fork and slowly roll toward the distal end, using the petri‑dish edge as a guide to keep perfect alignment.

steps.title: Fix Swiss roll in PFA
steps.instruction: Secure the roll with a 150‑µm minuten pin (using small forceps) placed through all layers between the fork tines, then place the roll in a 5‑mL tube containing 4 mL 4 % PFA and incubate at 4 °C for 24 h.

steps.title: Post‑fixation ethanol storage
steps.instruction: Transfer the fixed roll to an inclusion cassette, label the cassette with a pencil, and keep it in 70 % ethanol at 4 °C for at least 2 h before paraffin embedding.

steps.title: Dehydrate, clear, and infiltrate tissues
steps.instruction: Process the cassette in an ASP300 tissue processor: dehydrate through five successive 50‑min baths of absolute ethanol, clear in two successive Sub‑X baths (30 min then 40 min), then infiltrate in three 35‑min baths of liquid paraffin at 60 °C.

steps.title: Embed roll in paraffin block
steps.instruction: Fill a paraffin embedding mold with liquid paraffin using the HistoCore Arcadia H, position the roll surface at the bottom of the mold for correct orientation, cool the mold on the cold region of Arcadia H, place the cassette over the mold and verify it is surrounded by paraffin, then transfer the mold to the cold region of Arcadia C and unmold the solidified paraffin block.

steps.title: Section and dry slides
steps.instruction: Cut 3‑µm sections with a microtome, mount on slides, and dry the slides at 37 °C overnight.

steps.title: Dewax and rehydrate slides
steps.instruction: Dewax slides in two 30‑s baths of Bond Dewax solution at 72 °C followed by one bath at room temperature; then rehydrate quickly through three brief (few‑seconds) baths of 100 % ethanol.

steps.title: Hematoxylin‑eosin‑saffron staining
steps.instruction: Stain nuclei with Mayer’s Hemalun for 4 min 30 s, stain cytoplasm with 1 % aqueous eosin for 2 min, dehydrate through three 1‑min baths of ethanol (70 % then 100 % as described), stain collagen with 1 % alcoholic saffron for 3 min 30 s, pass slides through four 1‑min baths of 100 % ethanol, then three 1‑min baths of xylene, and finally coverslip with Pertex mounting medium.

steps.title: CD3 immunostaining
steps.instruction: Perform epitope retrieval in solution 2 (pH 9) for 20 min at 100 °C, block endogenous peroxidase with 3 % H₂O₂ in deionized water for 10 min, rinse with Bond wash buffer, incubate with anti‑CD3 antibody (1/100, clone D4V8L, #99,940) for 1 h at room temperature, rinse twice with wash buffer, incubate with ready‑to‑use Poly‑HRP anti‑Rabbit IgG (#PV6119) for 30 min at room temperature, rinse twice, wash 5 min, develop with DAB (mix one drop DAB chromogen with 1 mL substrate solution) for 5 min at room temperature, counterstain with hematoxylin for 5 min, rinse with water, and coverslip with Pertex at room temperature.

steps.title: Slide scanning and analysis
steps.instruction: Scan each slide on a Zeiss Axio Scan Z1 slide scanner and visualize the images using QuPath‑0.2.3 software.
